What each product in your LVR processing protocol protects against, and whether a vaccine
is modified-live (MLV) or killed. Always read the label, and call LVR at (785) 333-8384
with questions.

## Respiratory (pneumonia) vaccines

### Inforce 3 {#inforce-3}

**Modified-live (MLV) vaccine**  
**Protects against:** IBR (red nose), PI3, BRSV  
**Used for:** Pneumonia  
**Label dose:** 2 mL, Intranasal  
**Made by:** Zoetis  

### Pyramid 5 {#pyramid-5}

**Modified-live (MLV) vaccine**  
**Protects against:** IBR (red nose), BVD types 1 and 2, PI3, BRSV  
**Used for:** Pneumonia  
**Label dose:** 2 mL, Under the skin, neck  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 21 days  
**Made by:** Boehringer Ingelheim  

### Pyramid 5 + Presponse SQ {#pyramid-5-presponse-sq}

**Modified-live (MLV) vaccine**  
**Protects against:** IBR (red nose), BVD types 1 and 2, PI3, BRSV; Mannheimia haemolytica pneumonia (leukotoxoid)  
**Used for:** Pneumonia & shipping fever  
**Label dose:** 2 mL, Under the skin, neck  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 21 days  
**Made by:** Boehringer Ingelheim  

## Reproductive (abortion and breeding) vaccines

### Express FP 5-VL5 HB {#express-fp-5-vl5-hb}

**Modified-live (MLV) vaccine**  
**Protects against:** IBR (red nose), BVD types 1 and 2, PI3, BRSV; Vibriosis (Campylobacter fetus), leptospirosis (L. canicola, grippotyphosa, hardjo-bovis, icterohaemorrhagiae, pomona)  
**Used for:** Abortion & breeding diseases; pneumonia  
**Label dose:** 2 mL, Under the skin, neck  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 21 days  
**Made by:** Boehringer Ingelheim  

### Vira Shield 6 + VL5 {#vira-shield-6-vl5}

**Killed vaccine**  
**Protects against:** IBR (red nose), BVD types 1 and 2, PI3, BRSV; Vibriosis (Campylobacter fetus), leptospirosis (L. canicola, grippotyphosa, hardjo, icterohaemorrhagiae, pomona)  
**Used for:** Abortion & breeding diseases; pneumonia  
**Label dose:** 5 mL, Under the skin, neck  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 21 days  
**Made by:** Elanco  

## Clostridial (blackleg) vaccines

### Alpha-7 Cattle Vaccine {#alpha-7-cattle-vaccine}

**Killed vaccine**  
**Protects against:** Blackleg (C. chauvoei), malignant edema (C. septicum), black disease (C. novyi), C. sordellii, enterotoxemia (C. perfringens types C and D)  
**Used for:** Blackleg  
**Label dose:** 2 mL, Under the skin, neck  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 21 days  
**Made by:** Boehringer Ingelheim  

### Alpha-7/MB1 {#alpha-7-mb1}

**Killed vaccine**  
**Protects against:** Blackleg (C. chauvoei), malignant edema (C. septicum), black disease (C. novyi), C. sordellii, enterotoxemia (C. perfringens types C and D); pinkeye (Moraxella bovis)  
**Used for:** Blackleg & pinkeye  
**Label dose:** 2 mL, Under the skin, neck  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 60 days  
**Made by:** Boehringer Ingelheim  

### Alpha-CD {#alpha-cd}

**Toxoid vaccine (not live)**  
**Protects against:** Enterotoxemia (Clostridium perfringens types C and D)  
**Used for:** Enterotoxemia (overeating disease)  
**Label dose:** 2 mL, Under the skin, neck  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 60 days  
**Made by:** Boehringer Ingelheim  

### Vision 7 {#vision-7}

**Killed vaccine**  
**Protects against:** Blackleg (C. chauvoei), malignant edema (C. septicum), black disease (C. novyi), C. sordellii, enterotoxemia (C. perfringens types C and D)  
**Used for:** Blackleg  
**Label dose:** 2 mL, Under the skin, neck  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 21 days  
**Made by:** Merck  

## Dewormers and pour-ons

### Dectomax Pour-On {#dectomax-pour-on}

**Macrocyclic lactone (doramectin)**  
**Protects against:** Stomach and intestinal roundworms, lungworms, grubs, lice, mites, horn flies  
**Used for:** External/Internal parasites  
**Label dose:** 5 mL per 100 lb, Pour down the back  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 45 days  
**Made by:** Zoetis  

### Synanthic Bovine Dewormer Suspension 22.5% {#synanthic-bovine-dewormer-suspension-22-5}

**Benzimidazole (oxfendazole)**  
**Protects against:** Stomach and intestinal roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms  
**Used for:** Worms  
**Label dose:** 1 mL per 110 lb, In mouth  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 11 days  
**Made by:** Boehringer Ingelheim  

### Vetrimec Pour-On {#vetrimec-pour-on}

**Macrocyclic lactone (ivermectin)**  
**Protects against:** Stomach and intestinal roundworms, lungworms, grubs, lice, mites, horn flies  
**Used for:** Worms, flies & lice  
**Label dose:** 5 mL per 100 lb, Pour down the back  
**Slaughter withdrawal:** 48 days  
**Made by:** Norbrook
